source_refs.note: Topic 6.5.2 with the BISE certificate class activity (PDF 166-167, printed 163-164). Figure 6.4 shows a digital-identity attestation flow; it is described in words and not redrawn.

blocks.text: Banks and financial services use blockchain to make transactions faster and safer; sending money abroad, often slow and expensive, can become quicker and cheaper. Some artists use blockchain to sell digital art, with a unique digital signature proving each piece is the original (Did You Know).

blocks.alt: Digital identity flow: the User with an ID APP requests and receives attestations from Identity Issuer(s), presents them to Identity Verifier(s) for verification, and stores encrypted attestations in an Identity Hub. The app registers the identity on the blockchain, and the verifier looks the identity up there.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Blockchain in banking for faster and safer transactions (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 6.4).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The printed Figure 6.4 labels 'Identity Verifirt (s)'; it should be 'Identity Verifier(s)'.
